sources.title: [21.11] PoolFormer | DOCSAID
sources.snippet: By using pooling, a highly simplistic operation, as the Token-Mixer, the authors demonstrated the competitive performance of the PoolFormer model across various vision tasks, strongly supporting the claim that MetaFormer Is Actually What You Need for Vision.

sources.title: Poolformer: Recurrent Networks with Pooling for Long-Sequence Modeling
sources.snippet: Such models require mechanisms to exchange information along the time dimension, typically using recurrent or self-attention layers. However, self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length, limiting its practicality for very long sequences.
